description: This file defines a final class 'TokenStream' that manages a stream of parser tokens for Twig templates, including token navigation, expectation, and injection functionalities.

classes.name: TokenStream
classes.description: Manages a sequence of tokens, providing methods to traverse, inspect, and inject tokens, primarily used during template parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the token stream with an array of tokens and an optional source object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns all tokens as a concatenated string representation.

methods.name: injectTokens
methods.description: Inserts additional tokens into the current token list at the current position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token and returns the previous one; throws SyntaxError if end of tokens is reached unexpectedly.

methods.name: nextIf
methods.description: Checks if the current token matches given criteria; if so, advances and returns the token, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Verifies the current token matches expected type and value; advances the stream; throws SyntaxError if not matched.

methods.name: look
methods.description: Returns the token at a position relative to the current position without advancing.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Checks if the current token matches given criteria.

methods.name: isEOF
methods.description: Determines if the end of the token stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context associated with the token stream.
